workLog.action: Widened .claude/commands/research.md allowed-tools so /research keeps a source path and can write its documented outputs when WebFetch is denied
workLog.result: allowed-tools now grants Read, Write, Glob, Grep, and Bash scoped to the github skill script directory

workLog.action: Added two Fallback Rules to .claude/commands/research.md: route github.com through the github skill scripts, and treat a harness permission denial as a capability signal
workLog.result: The command no longer halts when a PreToolUse hook denies WebFetch

workLog.action: Added a control-plane carve-out to .claude/skills/research-and-incorporate/SKILL.md and its references/workflow.md
workLog.result: A hook denial reason is a routing fact, not ingested content the agent must refuse; the carve-out grants no authority to change task, destination, or scope

workLog.action: Replaced the raw gh issue create block in references/workflow.md Phase 5 with the github skill new_issue.py script and a --body-file write
workLog.result: Phase 5 is reachable under the new allowlist and carries no shell heredoc quoting

workLog.action: Added tests/commands/test_research_command_contract.py covering both the Claude source and the Copilot mirror
workLog.result: Positive, negative, and edge cases pin the tool contract so the two trees cannot drift

workLog.action: Derived the SkillForge mirror skip in scripts/validation/git_hook_policy.py from .claude/commands instead of a hardcoded name list, and removed the duplicate list from lefthook.yml
